# egeria-docs' HTML files (web_docs fixture)

Every .html file in odpi/egeria-docs at fb489c6b, copied byte for byte with
their paths (CC-BY-4.0, with the MIT notice of mkdocs-material's templates kept in the files).
These 7 files made egeria_docs' whole web_docs collection: 6 mkdocs-material custom_dir templates
under site/overrides and one meta-refresh redirect stub. test_web_docs_site_templates.py checks that
web_docs ingests none of them.
